entry_state: The language distinguishes preserved Core0 teaching syntax from proposed portable records and the whole-company typed profile. Exact quantities,unknowns,admission and content identity remain separate. Shared debt symbols preserve the continuous family;posting rules propose checked batches and resolve explicit overrides without hidden priorities. Alternative readings inherit constraints and share treatment choices. The discussion of new evidence and corrected assertions continues next;the compilation cross-reference on page97 is queued for repair.
exit_state: Language alternatives retain rejected history and separate evidence revision from posterior reweighting. Modules preserve semantic versions and typed errors have distinct recovery paths. Reconstruction retains scoped symbolic families;conditional runs disclose supplied assumptions. Event execution validates accounting authorization and jointly commits journal and economic state. The stable entity/book/branch/business-event key distinguishes retries from conflicts;the atomic retry transaction continues on the next page.

findings.observation: Module versions and typed diagnostics preserve changes of meaning and distinct recovery paths. There is no generic zero fallback for unknown required inputs.

The ingest/reconcile procedure preserves original readings and residuals,uses joint constraints and retains solver incompleteness. A supplied maturity assumption is displayed as conditional rather than promoted to historical fact.

The delivery case links economic basis,treatment permission,journal,delta and commit. Read-only assessment cannot be promoted by flipping a flag. Retry validation occurs before stable-key lookup,and exact committed fingerprints precede freshness checks.
